name: @activepieces/piece-browserless
description: Browserless is a headless browser automation tool that allows you to scrape websites, take screenshots, and more.

auth.description:
To obtain your API credentials:

    1. Sign up for a free Browserless account at https://www.browserless.io
    2. Navigate to your dashboard
    3. Find your API Key/Token in the account settings
    4. Choose your preferred regional endpoint for optimal performance

    Regional Endpoints:
    • US West (SFO): https://production-sfo.browserless.io
    • Europe UK (London): https://production-lon.browserless.io
    • Europe (Amsterdam): https://production-ams.browserless.io

    For custom/dedicated instances, select "Custom" and enter your specific endpoint URL.

apiToken.description: Your Browserless API token (found in your dashboard)

region.description: Choose the regional endpoint closest to you for optimal performance

customBaseUrl.description: Enter your custom Browserless endpoint URL

capture_screenshot.name: capture_screenshot
capture_screenshot.description: Take a screenshot of a web page

url.description: The URL of the page to capture

width.description: Width of the browser viewport in pixels

height.description: Height of the browser viewport in pixels

waitForSelector.description: CSS selector to wait for before taking screenshot

delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before taking screenshot

omitBackground.description: Hide default white background for transparent screenshots

clipX.description: X coordinate of the top-left corner for clipping

clipY.description: Y coordinate of the top-left corner for clipping

aiMetadata.description: Renders a web page in a headless browser and returns a PNG or JPEG screenshot of it. Use to capture the visual state of a public URL; the page URL is required, and options like full-page capture, viewport size, clipping region, and waiting for a CSS selector control what is rendered. Read-only: re-running with the same input re-renders the page and produces an equivalent image without side effects.

generate_pdf.name: generate_pdf
generate_pdf.description: Convert a web page to PDF

url.description: The URL of the page to convert to PDF

html.description: HTML content to render as PDF (alternative to URL)

headerTemplate.description: HTML template for the print header

footerTemplate.description: HTML template for the print footer

waitForSelector.description: CSS selector to wait for before generating PDF

waitForSelectorTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for waiting for selector

waitForSelectorVisible.description: Wait for selector to be visible

waitForSelectorHidden.description: Wait for selector to be hidden

preferCSSPageSize.description: Give any CSS @page size declared in the page priority over format

omitBackground.description: Hide default white background and allow transparent PDFs

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for the page to load

waitForFunction.description: JavaScript function to wait for before generating PDF

waitForFunctionPolling.description: Polling interval for wait function ("raf", "mutation", or number in ms)

waitForFunctionTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for wait function (0 to disable)

userAgent.description: Custom user agent string to use for the request

waitForTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds to wait before generating PDF

bestAttempt.description: Attempt to proceed when awaited events fail or timeout

aiMetadata.description: Renders content in a headless browser and returns it as a PDF file. Source the content either from a page URL or from a raw HTML string (provide exactly one, not both). Use to produce a printable PDF of a page or supplied markup, with control over paper format, orientation, margins, and headers/footers. Read-only: re-running with the same input re-renders an equivalent PDF without side effects.

scrape_url.name: scrape_url
scrape_url.description: Extract content from a web page

url.description: The URL of the page to scrape

elements.description: CSS selectors for elements to extract

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for this specific selector

waitForSelector.description: CSS selector to wait for before scraping

waitForSelectorTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for waiting for selector

waitForSelectorVisible.description: Wait for selector to be visible

waitForSelectorHidden.description: Wait for selector to be hidden

waitForTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds to wait before scraping

waitForEvent.description: Event name to wait for before scraping

waitForEventTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for wait event

debugConsole.description: Include console logs in debug output

debugNetwork.description: Include network requests in debug output

bestAttempt.description: Attempt to proceed when awaited events fail or timeout

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for the page to load

waitForFunction.description: JavaScript function to wait for before scraping (should return true when ready)

aiMetadata.description: Loads a web page in a headless browser and extracts the elements matched by the CSS selectors you supply. Use to pull specific text or attributes from a page rather than capturing an image; both the page URL and at least one element selector are required. Read-only: re-running with the same input re-scrapes the page and returns equivalent data without side effects.

run_bql_query.name: run_bql_query
run_bql_query.description: Execute Browser Query Language (BQL) GraphQL-based queries for advanced browser automation

query.description: GraphQL-based BQL query for browser automation. Example: mutation { goto(url: "https://example.com") { status } }

variables.description: Variables to pass to the BQL query (JSON object)

operationName.description: Name of the GraphQL operation to execute

stealth.description: Enable stealth mode for bot detection bypass

headless.description: Run browser in headless mode (set to false for GUI)

humanlike.description: Enable human-like mouse movement, typing, and delays

proxyCountry.description: Country code for residential proxy (e.g., us, gb, de)

proxySticky.description: Maintain same proxy IP across session

slowMo.description: Add delays between browser actions in milliseconds

ignoreHTTPSErrors.description: Ignore HTTPS certificate errors during navigation

cookies.description: Cookies to set before executing BQL query

url.description: Request-URI to associate with the cookie

secure.description: Indicates if the cookie is secure

httpOnly.description: Indicates if the cookie is HTTP-only

expires.description: Expiration date as timestamp (session cookie if not set)

aiMetadata.description: Runs a raw Browser Query Language (BQL) GraphQL query against a headless Chromium browser for advanced automation such as navigation, clicking, typing, and multi-step scripted browser flows. Use when the simpler screenshot/scrape/PDF actions cannot express the interaction; requires a valid BQL query string and supports session options like stealth, proxy, and cookies. Not idempotent: the query can perform stateful browser actions and side-effecting navigation, so repeating it may not yield the same result.

get_website_performance.name: get_website_performance
get_website_performance.description: Analyze website performance metrics using Lighthouse

url.description: The URL of the website to analyze

categories.description: Select which performance categories to analyze (performance, accessibility, best-practices, seo, pwa)

onlyCategories.description: Return only category scores without detailed audit results

locale.description: Locale for the analysis (e.g., en-US, de-DE)

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for the analysis to complete

waitForSelector.description: CSS selector to wait for before running performance analysis

budgets.description: Lighthouse performance budgets for resource sizes

stealth.description: Enable stealth mode for bot detection bypass

blockAds.description: Enable ad blocker during performance analysis

aiMetadata.description: Runs a Lighthouse audit on a public URL in a headless browser and returns performance, accessibility, best-practices, SEO, and PWA scores plus key metrics. Use to measure a page's quality; the URL is required, and you can scope the audit to specific categories and simulate a desktop or mobile device with network throttling. Read-only analysis: re-running with the same input re-audits the page without side effects (scores may vary slightly run to run).
